content.short: HyperDash is a trading terminal for Hyperliquid with real-time analytics and portfolio tracking.
content.description: HyperDash is a trading platform for Hyperliquid covering crypto perpetuals, spot that settles to the user's own wallet, and RWA perpetuals on stocks, pre-IPO companies, indices, commodities and FX through HIP-3 markets that stay open with no market holidays. A Perp RFQ facility sources firm quotes from market makers for block-size orders. Its analytics side includes a trader explorer for any Hyperliquid wallet, cohort views of market positioning by PnL and wallet size, live TWAPs and a cross-market leaderboard. Each asset carries its own leverage limit.
